definitions.explanation: Expressing one's thoughts or feelings honestly and directly without concealment or pretense. Carries a positive nuance of sincerity rather than rudeness.

examples.japanese: {率直|そっちょく}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}きたい→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I want to hear your frank opinion.

examples.japanese: {率直|そっちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Frankly speaking, there are problems with this plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{率直|そっちょく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{口|くち}にする→口にする：21471_kuchinisuru⟧。
examples.english: He has a candid personality and says exactly what he thinks.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective ({率直|そっちょく}な) or adverbially ({率直|そっちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). The phrase {率直|そっちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧ ("frankly speaking") is a common set expression used to preface an honest statement. Unlike ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧ which emphasizes moral honesty, {率直|そっちょく} focuses on directness of expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {率直|そっちょく}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: frank opinion
- {率直|そっちょく}な⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧: candid impression
- {率直|そっちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to speak frankly
- {率直|そっちょく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: straightforward personality
- {率直|そっちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to admit candidly
